content.headline: Five ways to write a better prompt
content.body: You do not need to shout at the AI. Quality improves when you give it a role, examples, and clear limits.
bullets: Zero-shot — just ask (quick but often generic)
Role prompting — "Act as a senior district officer drafting a public notice"
Few-shot — paste 1–3 examples of the format you want
Constraints — set word count, tone, and what to exclude
Chain-of-Thought — ask it to think step-by-step before answering
